[SWS_PHM_01345] Keep Elementary Supervision Status kOK
⌈
If the El-
ementary Supervision Status is kOK and the results of the corresponding su-
pervision are correct, i.e. all checkpoints are reported according to configuration and
in case of Alive Supervision the counter for failed Alive Supervision reference cy-
cles is zero, then the Platform Health Management shall keep the supervision in
the Elementary Supervision Status kOK.
⌋
